inlines.v: NUMER'ICAL, adjective [Latin , number.] 1. Belonging to number; denoting number; consisting in numbers; as numerical algebra; numerical characters. 2. numerical difference, is that by which one individual is distinguished from another. The same numerical body is identically the same.
